purpose: Irreversible disposal of exactly eight authorized synthetic native qualification documents after preserving their qualification proofs.
evidence_classification: Supported upstream HTTP API execution with independently returned metadata/status observations; not an upstream test suite, model trial, or new cold-seed acceptance.

sources.capability: Native document DELETE route, cascade contract, success response and missing-document 404.
Bank-serialized deletion, observation invalidation, stats eviction, native automatic maintenance and refresh scheduling.
Remove observations derived from deleted facts, reopen surviving sources for reconsolidation, and native retain can upsert a document again.
Retraction-aware single-page staleness, briefly incomplete batch staleness, and asynchronous best-effort refresh of automatic pages.
Metadata-only document listing and paginated operation summaries.

preconditions.authorization: Coordinator explicitly authorized only four owned Codex and four owned Claude synthetic qualification documents.
preconditions.independent_process_check: Two clean-production processes observed, then identified as the shared native app-server and code-mode infrastructure; no qualification client remained. Infrastructure stayed running.

execution.native_transport: rtk proxy curl --silent --show-error; exact IDs delivered privately; sequential DELETE requests.
execution.get_body_handling: Exact-document GET response bodies discarded to /dev/null; only HTTP status retained. Document bodies and chunks were never captured.
execution.checks_between_deletes: After each sequential deletion, complete metadata-set equality against the original set minus authorized deletions, independent 404, and absence of pending/processing retain work.

private_native_response_inventory.location: Private artifact location delivered separately to the coordinator; outside every checkout.

independent_observation.automatic_refresh_trigger_attribution: Not proven specifically deletion versus cron from returned metadata.

limitations: Source-document disposal is irreversible; previous qualification proof artifacts are preserved and unmodified.
Returned deletion counts cover directly associated units; the total number of invalidated observations is not exposed by this endpoint.

Deleting a document is not a durable suppression tombstone. Future queued/native capture of its content could recreate it; all known owned retention was terminal before disposal and no resurrection was observed.

Cached knowledge-page prose and page history are not synchronously purged. Native automatic refresh is asynchronous and best effort; no page content/history was read, edited, manually refreshed, or accepted here.

Batch page metadata may briefly report is_stale:false while a refresh is queued. Unproved conversation content was not inspected, so universal absence of canary facts from every source, page, or history is not claimed.
Background maintenance and refresh usage is unknown; no provider invoice or seed-success inference is made.

verification_corrections.claim: An empty decoded GitHub contents JSON response for memory_engine.py indicated a source mismatch.
verification_corrections.correction: The file exceeds 1 MiB and GitHub returned encoding:none; the empty decode comparison was unusable. gh api with Accept:application/vnd.github.raw+json returned 1187169 bytes matching the installed file exactly.
